Divided we fall, UNITED we Stand!! 
This is for former President Rodrigo Duterte. Let's us be UNITED!! 👊👊👊

Join us! 😊👊👊👊
Ang Kongreso ng Mamayang Pilipino ay magbubukas muli! Samahan nyo kami mga Ka-Bansa bukas, 7:00 - 10:00 PM 

🇵🇭 NAGKAKAISANG SIGAW: FREE PRRD! 
Samahan ang mga DDS sa buong mundo sa isang ONLINE RALLY para kay dating Pangulong Rodrigo Roa Duterte! 

🗓 Sabado, Agosto 23
🕖 7:00PM - 10:00PM (Manila Time)

👥 Hosted by: Maharlika, Atty. Harry Roque, at Prof. Ana Malindog-Uy
📌 Ang Zoom link ay ibibigay bago magsimula ang programa

In English: 
Join us! 😊👊👊👊
The Congress of the Filipino People will open once again!
Join us, fellow countrymen, tomorrow, 7:00–10:00 PM.

🇵🇭 UNITED BATTLE CRY: FREE PRRD!
Join the DDS around the world in an ONLINE RALLY for former President Rodrigo Duterte!

🗓 Saturday, August 23
🕖 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Philippine Time)

👥 Hosted by: Maharlika, Atty. Harry Roque, and Prof. Ana Malindog-Uy
📌 The Zoom link will be given before the program starts.

Maraming Salamat po! (Thank you very much!) 
#BringPRRDHome

Feel free to share mga Ka-Bansa! ❤️😊🙏

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Tropical Depression ISANG
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 22 August 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Rizal within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan, Metro Manila, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Quezon(San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, Mulanay, Catanauan, Buenavista, San Antonio, Tiaong, Dolores, Candelaria, Sariaya, Lucena, Tayabas, Lucban) and Bulacan(Balagtas, Bocaue, Bulakan, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, Santa Maria) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

[4:31PM] #OkotaIsolo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic movement from Cele towards Pako is smooth in both directions. The Cele Link Bridge inward Ijesha is equally free-flowing with no delays on the return journey. The inner stretch of Nwachukwu Drive connecting Cele is also moving well in both directions.

Along Ago Palace Road, traffic remains encouraging on both the inward and outward sections up to Apple Junction. Movement on Ibeh Road from Apata inward Transformer Junction through Ilasa Underbridge service lane is good, with the return stretch equally free. Similarly, traffic along the inner part of Ire Akari connecting Osolo Road is smooth in both directions.

However, there is slow movement around Oke Afa, from Pako through Kogberegbe, Ile Ibadan, Ishaga College, Omonide, Aye, and Limca Junction, inward LASUTECH Roundabout towards Daleko Bridge and onward to Palm Avenue Junction, largely due to market activities around Daleko.

Meanwhile, traffic flow around Five Star, Iyana Isolo, and Iyana Itire inward Ijesha Expressway—covering both the main carriageway and the service lanes—is moving well. For now, no impediments have been recorded.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:27PM] #LagosIsland #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement is steady from Adekunle intersection on 3rd Mainland Bridge inward Adeniji Adele Road, through Ilubirin–Sura junction and stretching down to Obalende Bridge inward Onikan, descending Flag House enroute CMS Bridge, and further down to UBA connecting Apongbon.

Traffic flow on Apongbon Bridge descending to Outer Marina inward CMS and towards the train station remains smooth and free. Likewise, movement from Nitel Junction to State House inward McWen Bridge by Officers Mess, down to Bonny Camp, is good.

Ascending Obalende Bridge inward Dolphin intersection by the emergency point, through Ilubirin, and down to Carter Bridge linking back to 3rd Mainland Bridge inward Iyana Oworo, is also clear with good flow.

There are currently no impediments, and officers are on ground effectively managing the situation.

#FollowLASTMA
